resolution.summary: Completed isolated local-only Apple SFSpeechRecognizer he-IL experiment after user permission. Known Hebrew fixture 4.948792s: initial recognition 32.585s, warm repeat 0.482936s (~10.25x real-time). Both output 10 timestamped segments, including grouped 'אורך וידאו' (misrecognition of עורך הווידאו) and normalized 42. Not reliable one-word-per-segment. Evidence .local/apple-stt-benchmark/result-cold.json and result-warm.json. No product changes, no long-recording or overall resource benchmark; requiresOnDeviceRecognition=true.
